capabilities: Open .prg files from the file list, ribbon, command palette or context menu in a read-only preview tab
Embed .prg previews in notes via prg-viewer code blocks with note-relative or vault-root paths
Zoom, pan and fit previews with wheel, drag, double-click and keyboard controls
Collapse embedded previews to a 40px bar and restore height and viewport
Render TextNode, Section, ConnectPoint, LineEdge, ArcEdge and MultiTargetUndirectedEdge objects
extras: README states all content was AI-generated with no human review and the plugin is not Obsidian-staff-reviewed. Supports only metadata.version 2.7.0, desktop only (mobile unverified), 64 MiB file and 32 MiB decompressed size limits, and does not render images, attachments, URL cards, SVG, doodles or quote blocks.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or display Project Graph .prg files, so they sit inert in the vault.

relations.evidence: Read-only viewer for Project Graph .prg files. Unofficial, not affiliated with Project Graph.

summary: Read-only viewer that renders Project Graph .prg files in Obsidian as preview tabs or embedded code blocks with zoom and pan.
